# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 43 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** The Serpent and the Fall Recounted

---

**43:1** 'The serpent came to me and said cunningly: "Why do you not eat of the tree in the middle of the garden? God knows that when you eat of it, your eyes will be opened."'

**43:2** 'I was deceived by the serpent's words and ate of the tree. I also gave some to your father, and he ate.'

**43:3** 'Immediately our eyes were opened and we knew we were naked, and we were ashamed.'

---
*SOPHIA: consensus rendering. Divergences logged in disagreement file.*
